# --attest-signing-key without --attest-signing-key-id uses the SPKI SHA-256 fingerprint

gen-ec-key attest.key attest.pub.pem

exec vens generate --llm=mock --attest --attest-signing-key=attest.key --llm-seed=7 --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 report.json output.cdx.json
stderr 'Attestation written'

# keyId == sha256 of attest.pub.pem's DER, i.e.
#   openssl pkey -in attest.key -pubout -outform DER | shasum -a 256
jsf-verify output.attestation.cdx.json attest.pub.pem default

-- config.yaml --
project:
  name: "attest-default-keyid"
  description: "Default signing key id"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
